correctness.rationale: For all m,n>=2 and 2<=r<m+n, K=full (r-1)-skeleton plus two pure simplices. Exactness of the full simplex chain complex gives the displayed equivariant oriented-r-chain quotient. A same-part transposition reversing any oriented (r+1)-vertex simplex makes each signed orbit coinvariant exactly Z/2. Pure orbits vanish and the complete next-boundary relation is (a mod 2)e_(a-1)+(b mod 2)e_a. Odd and even parity cases and the saturated endpoints are explicitly proved, not extrapolated. The dependency-free verifier independently checks the original signed-simplex and compressed orbit presentations at 70 finite parameters and the closed rank formula at larger parameter ranges; computations are supplemental only.

value.rationale: A natural integral invariant of the large symmetry group is completely classified for every m,n,r, despite nonequivariantly torsion-free homology. Its finite two-primary coinvariants, parity jump and endpoint thresholds are invisible to the known sphere multiplicities and rational representations; it supplies exact algebraic obstruction data for integral symmetry descent. It is an infinite structural theorem with a motivated natural invariant, not a single unmotivated finite count.
